title: Theory that nuclear fuels were used to alter gravity and time on nuclear bases

tellings.quote: nuclear fuels were used mid-century to alter gravity we know that gravity and time are linked in general relativity

plain: The idea is that in the 1950s, nuclear fuels at US nuclear bases were used to alter gravity, and so perhaps time, since general relativity, Einstein's theory, links the two. Michels floats this himself, drawing on the Netflix series Dark, as a possible reason why UFOs would be watching nuclear sites.
